 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-19475e1a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in g))
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    if not zero_cells:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in zero_cells), max(r for r, _ in zero_cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in zero_cells), max(c for _, c in zero_cells)
    # The non-background, nonzero object is the source pattern; reflect it horizontally into the zero patch.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    source = [g[r][sc0:sc1 + 1] for r in range(sr0, sr1 + 1)]
    for dr in range(r1 - r0 + 1):
        for dc in range(c1 - c0 + 1):
            g[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = source[dr][len(source[dr]) - 1 - dc]
    return g
"
